sourceChanges: code/server/sv_init.cpp: SV_SpawnServer runs six settling frames for wolfet, each calling GAME_RUN_FRAME and SV_BotFrame at the current time before advancing it, and runs its last frame the same way; every other profile keeps its frames

code/server/sv_init.cpp: SV_SpawnServer drops every wolfet bot from a single-player or co-op game type as well as when the map command asks, and gives a dropped wolfet bot an empty reason; every other profile still drops bots only when asked, with "was kicked"
platform: Windows 11; Windows x86 MSVC debugoptimized, strict warnings, dedicated server only (-Dbuild-client=false -Drtcw-development=true -Dwolfet-development=true -Dstvef-development=true)

et.exe.settleFrameLoop: 0x4469e6..0x446a12 (GAME_RUN_FRAME 8 at svs.time, SV_BotFrame 0x43efc0 at svs.time, then svs.time += 100)
et.exe.botDrop: 0x446a3f..0x446a7b (NA_BOT at +0x546d8 and killBots [ebp+0xc], single player 0x442cf0 or co-op 0x442cd0: SV_DropClient 0x441880 with "" at 0x5586ec)
et.exe.clientConnect: 0x446a82..0x446aa7 (GAME_CLIENT_CONNECT 2, firstTime 0, bot flag; a refusal drops with the game's reason)
et.exe.botBegun: 0x446abb..0x446af7 (state = CS_ACTIVE, gentity = SV_GentityNum 0x445320 with s.number, deltaMessage +0x48a20 = -1, nextSnapshotTime +0x48a30 = svs.time, GAME_CLIENT_BEGIN 3)
et.exe.finalFrame: 0x446b14..0x446b3a (GAME_RUN_FRAME and SV_BotFrame at svs.time, then svs.time += 100)
et.exe.SV_Map_f killBots: 0x440147..0x44017c (devmap or spdevmap; passed to SV_SpawnServer at 0x440194)

etded.exe.botDrop: 0x42d16f..0x42d1ab (0x429440 single player, 0x429420 co-op, SV_DropClient 0x427ea0 with "" at 0x4be549)

passCriterion: Both servers clean in every run; the fnTech3 load timeline equals retail etded.exe's line for line (loadMatchesRetail); the candidate's restart timelines equal the baseline's, since this change does not touch map_restart

unitFixture.result: passes on 2d35919 plus this change for all 13 profiles, game types 0-5 and killBots 0/1, and 14 mutations each fail it; the same checks fail on 2d35919's block at the wolfet profile (first frame at +100 instead of +0) and pass there with wolfet skipped
